_why: Measured on 2026-09-10 (WSL runner, gcd__2026-09-10): at 12 ns gcd/gf180mcuD/7t fails setup by 0.504 ns; propose_repairs() relaxed it to 13.2 ns and setup closed with one violation left — max fanout on clkbuf_2_3__f_clk/Z, a CTS leaf buffer driving 11 sinks against MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT 10. The resizer does not re-buffer clock nets, so the knob is CTS's own cluster size: CTS_SINK_CLUSTERING_SIZE 10 caps a leaf cluster at ten sinks. One variable against the last run.
